entities.name: Wilhelm Gottlob Tilesius von Tilenau
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wilhelm Gottlieb Tilesius von Tilenau was a German naturalist and explorer, physician, draftsman and engraver. He was a member of the Order of St. Vladimir and of the Legion of Honour.
